    static class Edge {
        int u, v, fl, c, n;
        Edge(int u, int v, int fl, int c, int n) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.fl = fl;
            this.c = c;
            this.n = n;

    static int[] dep = new int[505];

        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, w, head[u]));
        head[u] = e.size() - 1;
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]));
        head[v] = e.size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean Find() {
        Arrays.fill(v, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dep, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        v[s] = 1;
        dep[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = e.get(i).n) {
                if (i >= e.size()) continue;
                Edge edge = e.get(i);
                if (v[edge.v] == 0 && edge.fl < edge.c) {
                    p[edge.v] = i;
                    q.offer(edge.v);

                    dep[edge.v] = dep[x] + 1;

                }

        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int now) {
        if (x == t || now == 0)
            return now;
        int t_now = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = e.get(i).n) {
            if (i >= e.size()) continue;
            Edge edge = e.get(i);
            if (edge.c > edge.fl && dep[edge.v] == dep[x] + 1) {
                int delta = dfs(edge.v, Math.min(t_now, edge.c - edge.fl));
                if (delta == 0) {
                    dep[edge.v] = 0;
                }
                e.get(i).fl += delta;
                e.get(i ^ 1).fl -= delta;
                t_now -= delta;
                if (t_now == 0)
                    break;
            }
        }
        return now - t_now;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (Find()) {
            ans += dfs(s, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
